name: omnicore
description: Tooling for the omnicore DDD + CQRS framework: scaffold a new service (full CDC bench or a zero-infra SQLite MVP), decompose a whole-system/MVP description into a domain map and scaffold it entity by entity, add/evolve/remove CRUD entities (by hand or through the bundled spec-driven code generator, omnicore-gen), create and evolve read-side views, wire framework capabilities (gRPC surface, external API calls, cache, integration events, …) docs-first, convert a service's infrastructure posture (MVP ⇄ full CQRS, engine/transport swaps) reversibly, run the service with clickable links, generate and run a contract QA suite that proves the service's promised behaviors end to end, diagnose a misbehaving service, run one generator command (doctor, check, explain, adopt) against an existing project, upgrade the framework pin, and ask docs-first questions.
